sources.notes: NASA Exoplanet Archive Planetary Systems table: every published parameter set (all rows, not only default_flag=1). Row count observed 2026-10-03; it grows as papers are added, so record the actual count in the MANIFEST. Cite DOI 10.26133/NEA12 with access date and row count. Probe with TOP 200 returned HTTP 200 on 2026-10-03; full CSV estimated ~21 MB.
sources.query_adql: select pl_name,hostname,pl_letter,default_flag,soltype,pl_controv_flag,pl_refname,st_refname,pl_pubdate,releasedate,rowupdate,pl_rade,pl_radeerr1,pl_radeerr2,pl_radelim,pl_bmasse,pl_bmasseerr1,pl_bmasseerr2,pl_bmasselim,pl_bmassprov,pl_orbsmax,pl_orbsmaxerr1,pl_orbsmaxerr2,pl_orbsmaxlim,pl_insol,pl_insolerr1,pl_insolerr2,pl_insollim,pl_eqt,pl_eqterr1,pl_eqterr2,pl_eqtlim,st_rad,st_raderr1,st_raderr2,st_radlim,st_mass,st_masserr1,st_masserr2,st_masslim,st_teff,st_tefferr1,st_tefferr2,st_tefflim from ps order by pl_name

sources.notes: NASA Exoplanet Archive Planetary Systems Composite Parameters: one row per planet, values mixed across references; each value has a <param>_reflink column (may be the literal "Calculated Value"). This table has no rowupdate column (including it returns HTTP 400). Cite DOI 10.26133/NEA13. Probe with TOP 200 returned HTTP 200 on 2026-10-03; full CSV estimated ~7 MB.
